name: Integration Webhook Gateway & Ingestion Engine
description: B2B integration middleware that accepts incoming partner events, validates HMAC signatures, queues jobs, and emits downstream webhook deliveries.
userBrief: We need a secure webhook ingestion and relay engine for our B2B partners. Must validate incoming HMAC payloads, store raw delivery attempts in SQLite/PostgreSQL, allow developer API key auth, and offer an interactive API documentation portal.

expectedProfile.productPurpose: Secure partner webhook ingestion, signature verification, and delivery dispatch.
secondaryJobs: Query audit logs via REST API
